request.subject: SITE:VILLAGE

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass and the stone plate under the hamlet, so the cottages and the fence stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the three thatched cottages, the fence, the colours, outline and art style exactly the same.
